mapper.select: SELECT project_id FROM tech_artifact tech_enclosure WHERE id =#{productId}
select count(*) from mes_building_cargo_list WHERE audit_time IS NOT NULL and project_id = #{projectId}
select serial_number from mes_building_cargo_list WHERE audit_time IS NOT NULL and project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(audit_time,'%Y-%m') month, COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_building_cargo_list WHERE status & 12 AND bool_delete_enum=0 AND DATE_FORMAT( audit_time, '%Y')=DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y') AND shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(audit_time,'%Y-%m')

SELECT IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id=cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 AND DATE_FORMAT(cargo.audit_time,'%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime},'%Y')

SELECT IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id=cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 AND date(cargo.audit_time)=date(#{dateTime})

SELECT ( a.sum - b.sum ) from ( SELECT IFNULL(sum(cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight), 0) sum FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo.type = 1 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND date( cargo.create_time )<= date( #{dateTime})) a ,( SELECT IFNULL( sum( cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) sum FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = #{productType} AND cargo.type = 2 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND date ( cargo.create_time ) <= date ( #{dateTime})) b;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cargo.create_time, '%Y-%m') month, IFNULL(sum(cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight), 0) amount FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo.type = 2 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(cargo.create_time, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cargo.create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT car_model model, COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_building_cargo_list WHERE `status` & 12 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y')=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime} , '%Y') AND shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} GROUP BY car_model ORDER BY car_model*1 ASC

SELECT project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.shortName', project.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', IFNULL(artifact.total_net_weight,0)total_net_weight, IFNULL(cargo.amount,0)cargo_amount, IFNULL(in_warehousing.amount,0)in_warehousing_amount, IFNULL(in_warehousing.amount-cargo.amount,0)stock FROM contract_project project LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id,sum(net_weight*quantity) total_net_weight FROM tech_artifact GROUP BY project_id )as artifact ON artifact.project_id=project.id LEFT JOIN( SELECT cargo.project_id, IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) amount FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id = cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 GROUP BY cargo.project_id )as cargo ON cargo.project_id=project.id LEFT JOIN( SELECT cargo.project_id, IFNULL( sum( cargo.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) amount FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary cargo LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo.product_id = artifact.id WHERE cargo.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo.type = 1 AND cargo.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY cargo.project_id )as in_warehousing ON in_warehousing.project_id=project.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(project.create_time,'%Y')= DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime},'%Y') AND artifact.total_net_weight!=cargo.amount AND project.bool_delete_enum = 0 ORDER BY stock DESC

SELECT project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.short_name', project.serial_number 'project.serial_number', IFNULL(cargo.amount,0)cargo_amount, IFNULL(quantity_table.quantity,0)cargo_quantity FROM ( SELECT cargo.project_id, IFNULL( sum( cargo_link.quantity * artifact.net_weight ), 0 ) amount FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link cargo_link LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON cargo_link.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list cargo ON cargo_link.cargo_list_id = cargo.id WHERE cargo_link.product_type = ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND cargo_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargo.`status` & 12 AND date( cargo.audit_time )= date( #{dateTime} ) GROUP BY cargo.project_id ) AS cargo LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_building_cargo_list WHERE bool_delete_enum=0 and status & 12 AND date(audit_time )= date( #{dateTime} ) AND shipment_status != ${@com.hzchum.scim.mes.building.core.api.enums.cargoList.ShipmentStatusEnum@ABOLISH_DELIVERY.getType()} GROUP BY project_id ) quantity_table ON quantity_table.project_id = cargo.project_id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON cargo.project_id = project.id

select distinct cl.* FROM mes_building_cargo_list AS cl INNER JOIN contract_project AS cp ON cl.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.business_type = 2
and cl.bool_delete_enum = 0 and cl.shipment_status != 2 and DATE_FORMAT(cl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate} and DATE_FORMAT(cl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate} and cl.project_id = #{projectId}
and cl.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and cl.license_plate like concat('%',#{licensePlate},'%')
and cl.driver_name like concat('%',#{driverName},'%')
and cl.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and cl.audit_user_name like concat('%',#{auditUserName},'%')
and (cl.receipt_name like concat('%',#{receiptName},'%') or cl.audit_receipt_name like concat('%',#{receiptName},'%'))
and cl.status & #{status} > 0
order by cl.status asc , cl.id desc
mapper.sql: SELECT id, project_id, 1 AS product_type, quantity, IFNULL(net_weight,0) AS net_weight, IFNULL(gross_weight,0) AS gross_weight FROM tech_machine_part WHERE bool_delete_enum=0 AND bool_send_directly=1 AND relation_type=2 UNION ALL SELECT id, project_id, 16 AS product_type, quantity, IFNULL(net_weight,0) AS net_weight, IFNULL(gross_weight,0) AS gross_weight FROM tech_assemble WHERE bool_delete_enum=0 AND bool_send_directly=1
mapper.select:
SELECT s1.project_id, s1.`project.id`, s1.`project.name`, s1.`project.short_name`, s1.`project.serial_number`, s1.warehouse_quantity, s1.warehouse_mete, s1.warehouse_gross_mete, IFNULL( s2.send_quantity, 0 ) send_quantity, IFNULL( s2.send_mete, 0 ) send_mete, IFNULL( s2.send_gross_mete, 0 ) send_gross_mete, a.quantity, a.mete, a.gross_mete FROM ( SELECT s.project_id, cp.id 'project.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', (CASE cp.bool_required_warehouse WHEN 0 THEN SUM( s.quantity ) ELSE SUM(s.warehouse_quantity) END ) AS warehouse_quantity, (CASE cp.bool_required_warehouse WHEN 0 THEN SUM( s.quantity * a.net_weight ) ELSE SUM(s.warehouse_quantity* a.net_weight) END ) AS warehouse_mete, (CASE cp.bool_required_warehouse WHEN 0 THEN SUM( s.quantity * a.gross_weight ) ELSE SUM(s.warehouse_quantity * a.gross_weight) END ) AS warehouse_gross_mete FROM ( SELECT s.*, IFNULL( SUM( wsp.quantity ), 0 ) AS warehouse_quantity FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary s LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_storage_product AS wsp ON wsp.warehouse_summary_id = s.id AND wsp.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE s.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND s.product_type = 2 AND s.type = 1 AND s.warehouse_type IN ( 0, 2, 4 )
AND s.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
GROUP BY s.id ) s INNER JOIN tech_artifact a ON s.product_id = a.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON s.project_id = cp.id WHERE s.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND s.product_type = 2 AND s.type = 1 AND s.warehouse_type IN ( 0, 2, 4 )
AND YEAR(cp.create_time) = YEAR(#{dateTime})
AND (cp.short_name LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%') OR cp.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%') OR cp.name LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%'))
AND cp.status = #{projectStatus}
GROUP BY s.project_id HAVING warehouse_quantity > 0 ) s1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.project_id, SUM( s.quantity ) send_quantity, SUM( s.quantity * a.net_weight ) send_mete, SUM( s.quantity * ( CASE a.gross_weight WHEN 0 THEN a.net_weight ELSE a.gross_weight END ) ) send_gross_mete FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary s INNER JOIN tech_artifact a ON s.product_id = a.id WHERE s.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND s.product_type = 2 AND s.type = 2 AND s.warehouse_type IN ( 0, 2, 4 ) GROUP BY s.project_id ) s2 ON s1.project_id = s2.project_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT a.project_id, SUM( a.quantity ) AS quantity, SUM( a.quantity * a.net_weight ) AS mete, SUM( a.quantity * ( CASE a.gross_weight WHEN 0 THEN a.net_weight ELSE a.gross_weight END ) ) AS gross_mete FROM tech_artifact a WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY a.project_id ) a ON s1.project_id = a.project_id
AND a.quantity > IFNULL( s2.send_quantity, 0 )
AND a.quantity = IFNULL( s2.send_quantity, 0 )
UNION ALL SELECT cp.id AS project_id, cp.id AS 'project.id', cp.name AS 'project.name', cp.short_name AS 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number AS 'project.serial_number', flow.warehouse_quantity, flow.warehouse_mete, flow.warehouse_gross_mete, flow.send_quantity, flow.send_mete, flow.send_gross_mete, inventory.quantity, inventory.mete, inventory.gross_mete FROM contract_project cp INNER JOIN ( SELECT p.project_id, SUM(p.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(p.quantity*p.net_weight) AS mete, SUM(p.quantity*p.gross_weight) AS gross_mete FROM () p GROUP BY p.project_id ) inventory ON inventory.project_id=cp.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT s.project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type=1 THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS warehouse_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type=1 THEN s.quantity*p.net_weight ELSE 0 END) AS warehouse_mete, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type=1 THEN s.quantity*p.gross_weight ELSE 0 END) AS warehouse_gross_mete, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type=2 THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS send_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type=2 THEN s.quantity*p.net_weight ELSE 0 END) AS send_mete, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type=2 THEN s.quantity*p.gross_weight ELSE 0 END) AS send_gross_mete FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary s INNER JOIN () p ON p.id=s.product_id AND p.product_type=s.product_type AND p.project_id=s.project_id WHERE s.bool_delete_enum=0 AND s.type IN(1,2) AND s.warehouse_type IN(0,2,4) AND s.workshop_id=#{workshopId} GROUP BY s.project_id HAVING warehouse_quantity > 0 ) flow ON flow.project_id=cp.id WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum=0 AND YEAR(cp.create_time)=YEAR(#{dateTime})
AND (cp.short_name LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%') OR cp.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%') OR cp.name LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%'))
AND cp.status=#{projectStatus} AND inventory.quantity > flow.send_quantity AND inventory.quantity = flow.send_quantity AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary normal INNER JOIN tech_artifact parent ON parent.id=normal.product_id AND parent.bool_delete_enum=0 WHERE normal.project_id=cp.id AND normal.bool_delete_enum=0 AND normal.product_type=2 AND normal.type=1 AND normal.warehouse_type IN(0,2,4) AND normal.workshop_id=#{workshopId} GROUP BY normal.project_id HAVING SUM(CASE cp.bool_required_warehouse WHEN 0 THEN normal.quantity ELSE (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(nsp.quantity),0) FROM mes_building_warehouse_storage_product nsp WHERE nsp.warehouse_summary_id=normal.id AND nsp.bool_delete_enum=0) END) > 0 ) ORDER BY project_id

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', cp.project_content 'project.projectContent', a.quantity, a.totalLength, a.totalArea, a.send_quantity, a.sendTotalLength, a.sendTotalArea, a.sendTotalLength / a.totalLength * 100 ratio FROM( SELECT a.project_id, sum( quantity ) quantity, sum( a.totalLength ) totalLength, sum( a.totalArea ) totalArea, sum( a.send_quantity ) send_quantity, sum( a.sendTotalLength ) sendTotalLength, sum( a.sendTotalArea ) sendTotalArea FROM ( SELECT enclosure.project_id, enclosure.quantity, enclosure.quantity * enclosure.length totalLength, enclosure.quantity * enclosure.surface_area totalArea, IFNULL( send.quantity, 0 ) send_quantity, IFNULL( send.quantity * enclosure.length, 0 ) sendTotalLength, IFNULL( send.quantity * enclosure.surface_area, 0 ) sendTotalArea FROM tech_enclosure enclosure LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, workshop_id, sum( quantity ) quantity FROM mes_building_warehouse_record WHERE type = 2 AND product_type = 4 AND bool_delete_enum = 0
AND workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y/%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y/%m')
GROUP BY product_id, workshop_id ) send ON send.product_id = enclosure.id WHERE enclosure.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND enclosure.project_id in
#{projectId}
UNION SELECT part.project_id, part.quantity, IF(true, 0, 0) totalLength, IF(true, 0, 0) totalArea, IFNULL( send.quantity, 0 ) send_quantity, IF(true, 0, 0) sendTotalLength, IF(true, 0, 0) sendTotalArea FROM tech_standard_part part LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, sum( quantity ) quantity FROM mes_building_warehouse_record WHERE type = 2 AND product_type = 8 AND bool_delete_enum = 0
AND workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y/%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y/%m')
GROUP BY product_id ) send ON send.product_id = part.id WHERE part.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND part.relation_type = 4
AND part.project_id in
#{projectId}
) a GROUP BY a.project_id ) a LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON a.project_id = cp.id
and a.quantity = a.send_quantity
and a.quantity > a.send_quantity
and cp.settlement_status = 1
AND (cp.short_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or cp.serial_number like concat('%',#{projectName},'%') or cp.name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%'))
and cp.status = #{projectStatus}
ORDER BY ratio

SELECT s1.project_id 'project.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', SUM(s1.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(s1.quantity * e.length) AS total_length, SUM(s1.quantity * e.surface_area) AS total_area, IFNULL(SUM(s2.quantity), 0) AS send_quantity, IFNULL(SUM(s2.quantity * e.length), 0) AS send_total_length, IFNULL(SUM(s2.quantity * e.surface_area), 0) AS send_total_area, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(s2.quantity), 0) / SUM(s1.quantity) * 100, 18) AS ratio FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary s1 LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_summary s2 ON s1.product_type = s2.product_type AND s1.product_id = s2.product_id AND s1.workshop_id = s2.workshop_id AND s1.warehouse_type = s2.warehouse_type AND s2.type = 2 AND s2.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_enclosure e ON e.id = s1.product_id INNER JOIN contract_project cp ON s1.project_id = cp.id WHERE s1.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND s1.type = 1 AND s1.product_type = 4
AND YEAR(cp.create_time) = YEAR(#{dateTime})
AND (cp.short_name LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%') OR cp.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%') OR cp.name LIKE concat('%',#{projectName},'%'))
GROUP BY s1.project_id
HAVING quantity > send_quantity
HAVING quantity = send_quantity
ORDER BY s1.project_id

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', count( DISTINCT cargo.id ) cargoQuantity FROM mes_building_cargo_list cargo LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id=cargo.project_id WHERE cargo.product_type = 2 AND ( cargo.STATUS = 4 OR cargo.STATUS = 8 ) AND cargo.shipment_status != 2
AND DATE_FORMAT( cargo.create_time, '%Y/%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y/%m')
AND cargo.project_id=#{projectId}
GROUP BY cp.id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) date, IFNULL( sum( a.quantity * b.net_weight ), 0 ) cargoNetWeight, IFNULL( sum( a.quantity * b.gross_weight ), 0 ) cargoGrossWeight FROM mes_building_warehouse_record a INNER JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE a.product_type = 2 AND a.type = 2 AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, '%Y-%m' )

select project.id AS 'projectInfo.id', project.name AS 'projectInfo.name', project.short_name AS 'projectInfo.shortName', project.serial_number AS 'projectInfo.serial_number', monomer.id AS 'monomer.id', monomer.name AS 'monomer.name', area.id AS 'area.id', area.name AS 'area.name', part.id AS productId, part.serial_number, part.specification, part.material, part.length, part.net_weight, part.gross_weight, part.bool_all_part_send_directly,
part.quantity, part.total_net_weight, part.total_gross_weight AS totalGrossNetWeight,
SUM((artifact.quantity - artifact.subscription_quantity) * link.quantity) AS quantity, SUM((artifact.quantity - artifact.subscription_quantity) * link.quantity * part.net_weight ) AS total_net_weight, SUM((artifact.quantity - artifact.subscription_quantity) * link.quantity * part.gross_weight ) AS total_gross_net_weight,
0 AS quantity, 0 AS total_net_weight, 0 AS total_gross_net_weight,
SUM(artifact.subscription_quantity * link.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(artifact.subscription_quantity * link.quantity * part.net_weight ) AS total_net_weight, SUM(artifact.subscription_quantity * link.quantity * part.gross_weight ) AS total_gross_net_weight,
common.workshop_id, workshop.id AS 'workshop.id', workshop.name AS 'workshop.name', sum(common.quantity) quantity, sum(common.quantity * part.net_weight) total_net_weight, sum(common.quantity * part.gross_weight) total_gross_net_weight,
1 AS productType from tech_machine_part AS part
INNER JOIN tech_artifact_machine_part_link AS link ON part.id = link.machine_part_id and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_artifact AS artifact ON link.artifact_id = artifact.id and artifact.bool_delete_enum = 0
inner Join mes_building_warehouse_record common on common.product_id = part.id and common.type = 1 and common.product_type = 1 and common.warehouse_type in (0,2)
and common.warehouse_type = 0
and common.warehouse_type = 4
and common.warehouse_type = 2
inner Join mes_building_warehouse_record common on common.product_id = part.id and common.type = 2 and common.product_type = 1 and common.warehouse_type in (0,2)
and common.warehouse_type = 0
and common.warehouse_type = 4
and common.warehouse_type = 2
inner Join mes_building_warehouse_record common on common.product_id = part.id and common.type = 2 and common.product_type = 1 and DATE_FORMAT(common.create_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateMounthTime}, '%Y%m') and common.warehouse_type in (0,2)
and common.warehouse_type = 0
and common.warehouse_type = 4
and common.warehouse_type = 2
inner join ( select i.workshop_id, i.product_id, sum(i.quantity) - IFNULL(o.quantity,0) quantity from mes_building_warehouse_record i Left JOin ( select o.workshop_id, o.product_id, sum(o.quantity) quantity from mes_building_warehouse_record o where o.type = 2 and o.bool_delete_enum = 0 and o.project_id = #{projectId} and o.product_type = 1 and o.warehouse_type in (0,2)
and o.warehouse_type = 0
and o.warehouse_type = 4
and o.warehouse_type = 2
group by o.product_id,o.workshop_id ) o on o.product_id = i.product_id and o.workshop_id = i.workshop_id where i.type = 1 and i.bool_delete_enum = 0 and i.project_id = #{projectId} and i.product_type = 1
AND i.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
AND i.area_id = #{areaId}
and DATE_FORMAT(i.create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y')
and i.warehouse_type in (0,2)
and i.warehouse_type = 0
and i.warehouse_type = 4
and i.warehouse_type = 2
group by i.product_id,i.workshop_id ) common on common.product_id = part.id and common.quantity > 0
LEFT JOin contract_project project on project.id = part.project_id LEFT JOin plan_monomer monomer on monomer.id = part.monomer_id LEFT JOin plan_area area on area.id = part.area_id
LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = common.workshop_id
where part.bool_delete_enum = 0 and part.bool_send_directly = 1 and part.relation_type IN (2,18)

AND part.area_id = #{areaId}
AND part.serial_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{serialNumber},'%')
AND artifact.quantity > artifact.subscription_quantity
AND artifact.quantity = 0
AND artifact.subscription_quantity > 0
AND common.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
and DATE_FORMAT(common.create_time, '%Y' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y')
GROUP BY part.id
,common.workshop_id
ORDER BY part.id

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(clpl.quantity * a.net_weight),0) FROM mes_building_cargo_list_product_link clpl INNER JOIN mes_building_cargo_list cl ON cl.id = clpl.cargo_list_id AND cl.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_artifact a ON clpl.product_id = a.id AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE clpl.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND clpl.product_type = 2 AND cl.`status` IN (4,8) AND cl.delivery_status = 1 AND a.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
AND a.area_id = #{areaId}

and license_plate like CONCAT('%',#{licensePlate},'%')
GROUP BY license_plate )

select a.name supplierName, a.short_name projectName,
a.date date,
a.shippedWeight shippedWeight, b.totalWeight totalWeight from( SELECT s.`name`, p.short_name,
DATE_FORMAT( c.audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') date,
ROUND(sum( c.actual_weight )/ 1000, 2) shippedWeight FROM mes_building_cargo_list c INNER JOIN contract_project p ON p.id = c.project_id and p.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN mes_building_supplier_price sp ON sp.id = c.supplier_price_id and sp.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = sp.supplier_id and s.bool_delete_enum = 0 where c.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE( c.audit_time) >= DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE( c.audit_time) <= DATE(#{endDate})
AND p.id = #{projectId}
GROUP BY s.`name`,
DATE_FORMAT( c.audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d'),
p.short_name )a inner join( SELECT s.`name`, p.short_name, ROUND(sum(c.actual_weight) / 1000, 2) totalWeight FROM mes_building_cargo_list c INNER JOIN contract_project p ON p.id = c.project_id and p.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN mes_building_supplier_price sp ON sp.id = c.supplier_price_id and sp.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = sp.supplier_id and s.bool_delete_enum = 0 where c.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY s.`name`,p.short_name )b on a.name = b.name and a.short_name = b.short_name

SELECT CASE WHEN cl.audit_time is null THEN DATE_FORMAT( cl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) ELSE DATE_FORMAT( cl.audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) END AS date, cp.`name` projectName, cl.license_plate licensePlate, cl.`status` status FROM mes_building_cargo_list cl left join contract_project cp on cl.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 where cl.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( cl.create_time, '%Y-%m%d' ) >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY, '%Y-%m%d' )

SELECT a.mete as monthNetWeight, workshop.NAME as workShopName FROM ( SELECT IFNULL( sum( a.quantity * b.net_weight ), 0 ) mete, a.workshop_id FROM mes_building_warehouse_record a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE a.product_type = 2 AND a.type = 2 AND a.STATUS = 8 AND a.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND a.create_time < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY a.workshop_id ) a LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON a.workshop_id = workshop.id

SELECT a.mete as totalNetWeight, workshop.NAME as workShopName FROM ( SELECT IFNULL( sum( a.quantity * b.net_weight ), 0 ) mete, a.workshop_id FROM mes_building_warehouse_record a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact b ON a.product_id = b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE a.product_type = 2 AND a.type = 2 AND a.STATUS = 8 AND YEAR(a.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY a.workshop_id ) a LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON a.workshop_id = workshop.id
